'''2002 Kashyyyk Regionals''' was a Star Wars CCG regional held in Massachusetts on 27 April 2002. [[Steve Brentson]] won it. It is known from Andy Klema's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3713">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2002-06-06-ya-hott-kashyyyk-regionalsd3713/ ya-hott-kashyyyk-regionals], DeckTech (Andy "RexBanner7" Klema, 6 June 2002). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2002-06-06-ya-hott-kashyyyk-regionalsd3713/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 27 April 2002
* '''Site:''' Massachusetts
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS1]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Steve Brentson]]
